_comment: Each field turns on one support card at nobsdash.com/#support. Leave a field empty until that payment path is genuinely live — an empty field hides its card, and the whole Support section disappears when every field is empty. Never point these at a page that cannot actually accept money.

_howToEnable.githubSponsors: Enable GitHub Sponsors first (github.com/sponsors — onboarding, bank and tax details). Only once your public sponsors page loads for a signed-out visitor, set this to https://github.com/sponsors/acburgess25
_howToEnable.donateOneTime: Stripe Dashboard → Payment Links → create a one-time link, paste the https://buy.stripe.com/... URL here
_howToEnable.donateMonthly: Stripe Dashboard → Payment Links → create a recurring link, paste the https://buy.stripe.com/... URL here
_howToEnable.supportInApp: Set true only once the app is installable (TestFlight public link or App Store) AND the tip/subscription products are cleared for sale in App Store Connect
